children.name: Nephasoma columbaris Kawauchi & Rice, 2009
children.description: External morphology: Holdfast papillae have a round shape. The larger (80-300 µm) ones have a hardened anterior margin usually appearing as a thin, pale border, which occasionally extends around the entire margin. Hooks are type I, slightly bent, spinelike (30-90 µm tall). Tentacular crown consists of 20-30 tentacles. Internal anatomy: Dorsal and ventral retractor muscles (DRM and VRM) are of equal size and originate at the end of the trunk. DRM has one origin and VRM may have one but usually shows two origins. Esophagus attaches to the VRM. Intestine consists of one or two loops plus the spiral. (From Stephen and Edmonds, 1972; Cutler and Cutler, 1985; Cutler, 1994)

children.name: Golfingia muricaudata
children.description: (EMU- 13446) Trunk 50 mm in length; rough, light brown body wall; scattered thin, cylindrical papillae. Caudal appendage 10 % of trunk length, covered with cylindrical papillae. Introvert incomplete, shorter than trunk. Longitudinal musculature continuous. Four retractor muscles (RM), dorsal RM attached to body wall anteriorly to ventral pair and more separated from ventral nerve cord. Esophagus attached to ventral RM. Two sack-shaped nephridia; nephridiopores open anteriorly anus; without spindle muscle; rectum with six thin lateral muscles; ventral nerve cord ends before internal anterior margin of caudal appendage. Habitat Bathyal (1045 m); muddy sand bottom.

children.name: Thysanocardia catharinae
children.description: Spindle-shaped, sand-coloured trunk 3 – 9 mm long, 1 – 1.5 mm wide, with minute papillae and characteristic sinuous wrinkles of cuticular microrelief; introvert subequal to or 1.5 X trunk length. Tentacular apparatus with dorsal arc of tentacles, oral crown with longitudinal festoon of tentacles; tentacles of living specimens with yellow tips, colourless in fixed worms. Body wall with continuous muscle layers. Two wide retractor muscles originate in the posterior trunk, about 10 – 15 % of trunk length from the posterior end. Gut with 6 – 10 loops. Spindle muscle not attached posteriorly. Contractile vessel with numerous villi. Nephridia are free, about 35 % of trunk length; nephridiopores are at the level of the anus.
